name: puppy-todo
description: your own to-do list in a quiet pane: add, tick, delete. it can also show, read-only, what a board in a status folder waits on you for

status_dir.title: Status folder
status_dir.description: Optional. A folder of pipeline-status files (see FORMAT.md in the repo). Each file with waiting items shows as a read-only card under your list. Empty: only your own list. ~ is your home folder.
